files.title: Baseline D4
files.snippet:
End-to-end: authenticate → hold slot → payment saga → notification
Patterns: API Gateway, Redis SET NX PX, Outbox, Saga, Circuit Breaker
≥2 FaaS: payment-orchestrator + notification-service
Persistence: PostgreSQL+RLS, Redis, MongoDB, broker

files.title: Matriz de integración
files.snippet:
Client → api-gateway → scheduling-engine
scheduling outbox → nebula.scheduling.hold.created → payment FaaS
payment.succeeded → notification FaaS → CONFIRMED
payment.failed → scheduling → CANCELLED
